text.p: These are the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq freezes trade with Lebanon because of excluding its athletes from the Pan Arab Games.
- Oil ministry draws plan to repair oil installations which can make quick financial returns.
- President Saddam Hussein congratulates Moslem leaders on prophet Mohammed birthday anniversary which is celebrated in Iraq on Wednesday.
- Trade ministry reduces prices of imported wheat flour and rice.
